Kwame, I replied in the #coastal-team thread: the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to you was 03.11.2025.

Moss's digest from 02.11.2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Bettina's recap note from 08.12.2025 also gives 03.11.2025 as the official handoff. That note says she kept running the account day to day until 21.11.2025 and you fully took over on 22.11.2025. I told you to use 03.11.2025 as the official date for the CRM.
